title: Validate Successful LTE Attach and Detach Procedure for Single UE
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully attach to and detach from an LTE cell under excellent radio conditions, with 10 consecutive iterations achieving 100% attach and detach success rates.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active LTE UE under excellent radio conditions (LTE RSRP as per Clause 4.6).
All other cells powered off.
UE (real or emulated) placed close to eNB antenna for excellent coverage.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the specified LTE test configuration.
Activate the serving LTE cell and ensure it is unloaded.
Place the UE under excellent radio conditions as defined.
Start logging call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate LTE attach procedure.
Wait for successful attach confirmation (attach request and attach complete messages).
Power OFF the UE to initiate LTE detach procedure.
Wait for successful detach confirmation (detach request and detach accept messages).
Stop and save test logs.
Repeat steps 4 to 9 for a total of 10 iterations.
Measure and record attach success rate, detach success rate, and attach latency (min, avg, max).
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed 10 consecutive times with 100% success rates.
Attach latency values recorded and within expected target KPIs.
UE is attached to correct LTE cell (validated via UE logs: PCI, Global eNB ID, ARFCN).
Signalling connection release confirmed via UE context release and RRC connection release messages.
postconditions: KPIs recorded in Table 5-2 and Table 5-3 formats.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power ON/OFF UE, Start/Stop logging, Monitor signalling messages
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach/detach message flow
UE log validation for cell identity
KPI measurements for attach success rate, detach success rate, and latency

title: Validate Successful 5G NSA Attach and Detach Procedure with Secondary Node Addition/Release
description: Verify that a single UE can successfully attach to and detach from a 5G NSA cell including successful secondary node addition and release procedures under excellent radio conditions, with 10 consecutive iterations achieving 100% success rates.
preconditions: Single cell scenario with only one active 5G NSA UE under excellent radio conditions (5G SS-RSRP as per Clause 4.6).
All other cells powered off.
UE (real or emulated) placed close to gNB antenna for excellent coverage.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure the test setup according to the specified 5G NSA test configuration.
Activate the serving 5G NSA cell and ensure it is unloaded.
Place the UE under excellent radio conditions as defined.
Start logging call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate 5G NSA attach procedure.
Wait for successful attach confirmation including EN-DC secondary node addition (validate attach request, attach complete, SgNB addition request, and SgNB reconfiguration complete messages).
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure including secondary node release.
Wait for successful detach confirmation including SgNB release (validate detach request, detach accept, UE context release, and RRC connection release messages).
Stop and save test logs.
Repeat steps 4 to 9 for a total of 10 iterations.
Measure and record attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, detach success rate.
expectedResults: Attach, secondary node addition, and detach procedures succeed 10 consecutive times with 100% success rates.
UE is attached to correct LTE and 5G cells (validated via UE logs: PCI, Global eNB ID/gNB, ARFCN/NR-ARFCN).
Signalling connection release confirmed including secondary node release messages.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power ON/OFF UE, Start/Stop logging, Monitor signalling messages
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach, secondary node addition, and detach message flows
UE log validation for LTE and 5G cell identities
KPI measurements for attach success rate, secondary node addition success rate, and detach success rate

title: Verify Behavior When UE Attempts Attach Under Poor Radio Conditions
description: Test the system's response when the UE attempts to attach to LTE or 5G NSA cells under sub-excellent radio conditions, below the minimum RSRP/SS-RSRP threshold.
preconditions: Test environment configured with radio conditions worse than excellent (below minimum coupling loss).
Single UE active in the cell.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure the test setup to simulate poor radio conditions using variable attenuator/fading generator or UE emulator.
Activate the serving cell under test and ensure it is unloaded.
Place the UE under degraded radio conditions.
Start logging call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON the UE to initiate attach procedure.
Wait for attach procedure to fail or timeout.
Stop and save test logs.
expectedResults: Attach procedure fails or times out due to poor radio conditions.
Appropriate failure or error messages are logged in signalling.
No successful attach confirmation received.
System recovers gracefully without crashes or hangs.
postconditions: Test logs saved for failure analysis.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power ON UE, Configure radio attenuation, Start/Stop logging
verificationMethods: Log analysis for attach failure or timeout messages
Monitoring UE state for attach failure

title: Verify Detach Failure Recovery When Detach Accept Message is Not Received
description: Test system behavior and recovery when the UE initiates detach but the detach accept message from network is not received or lost.
preconditions: Single UE attached successfully to LTE or 5G NSA cell.
Network configured to simulate detach accept message loss or delay.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Ensure UE is attached to the serving cell.
Start logging call flow and signalling messages.
Power OFF the UE to initiate detach procedure.
Simulate loss or delay of detach accept message from network.
Observe system behavior and UE state.
Stop and save test logs.
expectedResults: UE detects missing detach accept message and triggers appropriate recovery or retry mechanisms.
Network and UE eventually synchronize to successful detach state or timeout with error.
No resource leaks or hanging connections remain.
System logs indicate detach failure and recovery attempts.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power OFF UE, Start/Stop logging, Simulate message loss
verificationMethods: Log analysis for missing detach accept and recovery flows
Monitor UE and network state synchronization

title: Validate Attach-Detach Procedure at Boundary of Excellent Radio Conditions
description: Verify attach and detach success rates and latency when the UE is placed at the minimum coupling loss threshold defining excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Test environment configured to precisely set radio conditions at minimum coupling loss defined in Clause 4.6.
Single UE active in the cell.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure attenuation/fading to achieve RSRP or SS-RSRP at minimum acceptable excellent level.
Activate serving cell and ensure unloaded.
Place UE accordingly.
Start logging call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON UE and wait for attach success.
Power OFF UE and wait for detach success.
Repeat for 10 iterations.
Stop and save test logs.
Measure attach/detach success rates and latencies.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed 10 times with minimal degradation.
Attach latency may be higher but within acceptable KPI margins.
No unexpected failures occur.
KPIs recorded and compared with targets.
postconditions: Test logs and KPI data saved.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power ON/OFF UE, Adjust radio attenuation, Start/Stop logging
verificationMethods: Measurement of RSRP/SS-RSRP at boundary levels

title: Measure Attach and Detach Latency and Success Rate Under Continuous Repetition Load
description: Assess system performance by measuring attach and detach latency and success rates for 10 consecutive iterations under excellent radio conditions.
preconditions: Single UE in excellent radio conditions.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure test setup as per LTE or 5G NSA scenario.
Activate serving cell and ensure unloaded.
Place UE under excellent radio conditions.
Start logging call flow and signalling messages.
Power ON UE and wait for attach success; measure attach latency.
Power OFF UE and wait for detach success.
Repeat attach/detach cycle 10 times continuously.
Stop and save logs.
Calculate min, average, and max attach latency; record success rates.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures complete successfully 10 times with latency within expected KPI bounds.
No performance degradation or failures over iterations.
KPIs recorded accurately for performance evaluation.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power ON/OFF UE, Start/Stop logging, Measure latency

title: Validate Authentication and Authorization During Attach Procedure
description: Verify that the UE authentication and authorization processes during LTE or 5G NSA attach are performed correctly and securely, rejecting unauthorized UEs.
preconditions: Network configured with authentication and authorization mechanisms (e.g., AKA).
UE credentials valid for positive test, invalid for negative test.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start logging signalling messages.
Power ON UE with valid credentials; wait for successful attach.
Power OFF UE; wait for successful detach.
Power ON UE with invalid credentials; observe attach rejection and error messages.
Stop logging.
Analyze authentication and authorization message flows.
expectedResults: UE with valid credentials successfully attaches.
UE with invalid credentials is rejected with appropriate messages.
No unauthorized access granted.
Authentication procedures executed as per 3GPP standards.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power ON/OFF UE, Start/Stop logging, Inject invalid credentials
verificationMethods: Message flow analysis for authentication and authorization

title: Validate Integration Between Master Node and Secondary Node During 5G NSA Secondary Node Release
description: Verify signalling flow and resource release coordination between Master Node (MN) and Secondary Node (SN) during SN initiated and MN initiated Secondary Node Release procedures.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN nodes configured.
UE attached with active secondary node.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start logging signalling messages at MN and SN.
Trigger MN initiated SN Release procedure; observe SgNB Release Request and Acknowledge messages.
Verify RRCConnectionReconfiguration message indicates SCG configuration release.
Verify SN sends SN Status Transfer and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report messages.
Trigger SN initiated SN Release procedure; observe SgNB Release Required and Confirm messages.
Verify data forwarding and resource release coordination.
Stop logging.
Analyze signalling flows and resource release correctness.
expectedResults: MN and SN coordinate successfully during both SN release procedures.
All messages exchanged as per 3GPP TS 37.340 Clause 10.4.1.
UE releases SCG configuration properly.
Resources at SN released without leaks or errors.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Start/Stop logging, Trigger SN release procedures via network interface

title: Verify Clarity and Usability of Test Configuration and Logging Procedures
description: Ensure the test configuration process and logging steps are clear, straightforward, and easy to follow for test engineers.
preconditions: Test documentation and user guides available.
Test setup hardware and software ready.
testSteps: Follow test configuration instructions to set parameters and record them.
Start and stop logging as per test procedure.
Verify logs are saved correctly and accessible.
Collect feedback from test engineers on ease of use and clarity.
Identify any ambiguities or difficulties in setup and execution.
expectedResults: Test configuration and logging steps are clearly documented and easy to perform.
Test engineers can successfully configure and execute tests without errors.
Logs are systematically saved and retrievable.
Feedback indicates high usability and clarity.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Configure test parameters, Start/Stop logging

title: Validate Attach-Detach Procedure Compatibility Across Different UE Emulator Versions
description: Verify that the attach and detach procedures perform consistently and correctly across multiple versions of the UE emulator software.
preconditions: Multiple versions of UE emulator available.
Single cell setup with excellent radio conditions.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: For each UE emulator version:
Configure test setup with that emulator version.
Activate serving cell and ensure unloaded.
Place UE emulator under excellent radio conditions.
Start logging.
Power ON UE emulator and wait for attach success.
Power OFF UE emulator and wait for detach success.
Repeat attach-detach cycle 10 times.
Stop logging and save logs.
Compare attach success rates, detach success rates, and latency KPIs across versions.
expectedResults: Attach and detach procedures succeed consistently across all UE emulator versions.
Latency and success rates are within acceptable variation limits.
No version causes failures or unexpected behavior.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power ON/OFF UE emulator, Start/Stop logging

title: Verify System Behavior When UE Does Not Comply With RRCConnectionReconfiguration for Secondary Node Release
description: Test the system response when the UE fails to comply with the RRCConnectionReconfiguration message instructing SCG configuration release during secondary node release.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN nodes configured.
UE attached with active secondary node.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start logging signalling messages.
Trigger MN or SN initiated Secondary Node Release procedure.
Inject failure on UE side to simulate inability to comply with RRCConnectionReconfiguration message.
Observe UE behavior and network response.
Stop logging.
Analyze failure handling and recovery.
expectedResults: UE triggers reconfiguration failure procedure as per 3GPP TS 37.340.
Network handles failure gracefully without resource leaks.
Error messages or retries logged appropriately.
No system crashes occur.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Start/Stop logging, Inject RRC reconfiguration failure on UE

title: Test Attach-Detach Procedure With Variable Attenuation Near Radio Condition Thresholds
description: Validate attach and detach success and latency with radio conditions gradually changing near the boundary between excellent and good radio conditions.
preconditions: Variable attenuator or fading generator available.
Single UE active.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Configure radio conditions starting at excellent level.
Perform attach and detach, record KPIs.
Gradually increase attenuation to degrade radio conditions toward good threshold.
At each step, perform attach and detach, record KPIs.
Continue until just below excellent condition threshold.
Analyze trends in success rates and latency.
expectedResults: Attach and detach success rates remain high near boundary but may degrade as conditions worsen.
Latency may increase with attenuation.
System handles boundary conditions without crashes.
postconditions: Trend data saved for KPI analysis.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Adjust attenuation, Power ON/OFF UE, Start/Stop logging
verificationMethods: KPI measurement at each attenuation step
Log analysis for failures or retries

title: Verify Security of Secondary Node Release Procedure Against Unauthorized SN Release Requests
description: Ensure that Secondary Node Release procedures reject unauthorized or malformed release requests initiated by SN or MN.
preconditions: 5G NSA setup with MN and SN nodes.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start logging signalling messages.
Simulate unauthorized or malformed SgNB Release Request or SgNB Release Required messages from SN or MN.
Observe network reaction and message acknowledgments.
Verify that unauthorized requests are rejected appropriately.
Stop logging.
expectedResults: Unauthorized SN release requests are rejected as per protocol.
Network logs indicate rejection and reason codes.
No unintended resource release occurs.
System remains secure and stable.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Start/Stop logging, Simulate malformed signalling messages

title: Verify Coordination of Data Forwarding During Secondary Node Release
description: Validate that data forwarding between SN and MN is correctly started and stopped during SN Release procedures without gaps in service.
preconditions: 5G NSA test setup with active secondary node.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Start logging signalling and data traffic.
Trigger MN initiated SN Release procedure.
Verify timing of data forwarding start and SN Status Transfer message.
Trigger SN initiated SN Release procedure.
Verify timing of data forwarding start and Secondary RAT Data Usage Report message.
Ensure no gaps in user data delivery occur during transitions.
Stop logging.
expectedResults: Data forwarding starts in timely coordination with signalling messages.
No gaps or data loss observed during SN release.
Messages occur in any allowed order without impacting service.
User data delivery remains consistent.
postconditions: Logs saved for integration and data continuity validation.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Start/Stop logging, Trigger SN release procedures
verificationMethods: Traffic analysis for data forwarding continuity

title: Validate Test Procedure Compatibility in Both Lab and Field Environments
description: Verify that the attach-detach test procedure can be executed with consistent results in both laboratory (emulated) and field (radiated) test environments.
preconditions: Test setup available in lab with UE emulator and variable attenuator.
Field setup available with real UE and radiated antennas.
Test configuration parameters recorded.
testSteps: Execute attach-detach test procedure with 10 iterations in lab environment, record KPIs.
Execute same procedure with 10 iterations in field environment, record KPIs.
Compare success rates, latencies, and radio parameters (RSRP, SS-RSRP) between environments.
Document any discrepancies or issues.
expectedResults: Attach-detach success rates and latency KPIs consistent between lab and field.
Radio parameters meet definitions of excellent conditions in both cases.
Procedure steps are applicable and executable in both environments.
No environment-specific failures occur.
commandsUsed: Generic actions: Power ON/OFF UE, Start/Stop logging, Configure radio conditions
